features.text: Advanced posture correction system with integrated thoracic support panels
Innovative pulley mechanism provides customizable compression and alignment
Premium breathable materials ensure comfort during extended posture training
Versatile design supports both posture improvement and spinal condition management

measurement: Measure your waist at its narrowest point to select between S/M (25"-40" waist) and L/XL sizes. For personalized sizing assistance and optimal posture correction results, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Promise program.
